name: Lehman Brothers Holdings Capital Trust IV
summary: Lehman Brothers Holdings Capital Trust IV is a trust associated with the former Lehman Brothers Holdings Inc., which is currently undergoing bankruptcy or reorganization proceedings. The trust's preferred stock trades on the OTC Pink Limited market. It is not current in its reporting obligations. The primary purpose of the entity at present appears to be managing the residual affairs and obligations stemming from the Lehman Brothers bankruptcy, rather than engaging in active business operations or offering new products or services.
